to.standard: GUMO (Heckmann et al., UM 2005; Ubiquitous User Modeling, 2006)
to.concept: privacy box (key, owner, access, purpose, retention)

scope: Informative crosswalk between formats; never a conversion of a person's data without the person's grant
lost: owner → grantor; access → audience and grantee; purpose → purposes; retention → expiresAt. GUMO privacy values are qualitative, so OHC's typed scope, actions and step-up have no GUMO counterpart; key is not carried.
